metadata.description: The solution abbreviation.
The environment abbreviation.
The Azure subscription ID where the resources will be deployed.
The Azure region where the resources will be deployed. See https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/explore/global-infrastructure/geographies/#overview
The Azure region where the UI will be deployed. Could be the same value as the 'location' parameter or different.
The Azure AD tenant id.
The object id of the group that will be added as an administrator to the SQL server. Make sure you are a member of this group.
The name of the group that will be added as an administrator to the SQL server.
The list of data owners for the App Configuration. PrincipalId is the object id of the user, group, or service principal. principalType is the type of the principal, pick only one value.

The type of authentication to use for the App Configuration. UserAssignedManagedIdentity is recommended and will use <solution>-identity-<environment>-Graph. ClientSecret and Certificate will use <solution>-Graph-<environment>.

The name of the certificate in the Key Vault. This is required if the authenticationType is Certificate. This is only used by application <solutionAbbreviation>-Graph-<EnvironmentAbbreviation>. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/key-vault/certificates/quick-create-portal for more information on certificates.

The name of the certificate in the Key Vault. This is required if the authenticationType is Certificate. This is only used by application <solutionAbbreviation>-TeamsChannel-<EnvironmentAbbreviation>. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/key-vault/certificates/quick-create-portal for more information on certificates.
List of IP ranges or individual addresses to whitelist. Example value: ['192.168.1.1/32', '10.0.0.1'] (make sure to use double quotes).
If you don't want to send email notifications set this to true. When this is true, 'senderUsername','senderPassword','supportEmailAddresses' should be set to 'not-set'.

If you are not able or don't want to use delegated Mail.Send permission, you can grant application permission Mail.Send to the <solution>-Graph-<environment> or <solution>-identity-<environment>-Graph application depending on the authentication type selected. Then set this parameter to true.
The email address of the user that will be used to send emails.
The password of the user that will be used to send emails.
The email addresses of the users that will receive support emails.
The object id of the service account that will be used to manage Teams channels.
The username of the service account that will be used to manage Teams channels.
The password of the service account that will be used to manage Teams channels.
The Azure AD secondary tenant id. Only requires if the Azure resources are hosted in a different tenant from the one where users reside.
The provider id of the notifier. See https://github.com/microsoftgraph/group-membership-management/blob/main/Documentation/NotifierSetup.md
The SharePoint domain of the tenant.
The domain of the tenant.
The name of the ADF pipeline producing SqlMembership tables.
Flag to indicate whether this is the initial deployment.
Flag to set RBAC permissions for the service principals from the script.
Flag to set RBAC permissions for some service principals from the bicep templates.
Flag to create and set up the App Registrations leveraged by GMM.
Flag to skip the app registration setup (API permissions). Set it to true to speed up the deployment if your App Registrations are already up to date with the required API permissions.
Flag to skip the deployment of Azure Data Factory resources.
Flag to skip setting up Sql Server permissions.
Flag to skip the resource providers check.
Flag to indicate whether to start Azure Functions after deployment.
Flag to create resource groups. Set to true on initial deployment.
Flag to indicate whether to assert user permissions before deployment.
Flag to indicate whether to set user assigned managed identity permissions.
The type of reset to perform on GMM.
Location of AI resources. Default is westus3.
